QuestInfo.name: Beginner Bowman's Second Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You feel your muscles forming along your upper arms, but you've got a long way to go. Talk to #b#p1012100##k again.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012100# says the best way to learn is to hunt monsters. She says to hunt #r20 #o1210102#s#k. \n\n#o1210102# #r#a21371##k
QuestInfo.2: 20 #o1210102#s, slain and looted. You reported the news to #p1012100#.

0.0: 당신의 기량이 전보다 늘었군요. 하지만 그것으론 부족하지요. 당신에겐 아직 더 많은 수련이 필요하다고 판단되는군요. 어떤가요? 당신만 원한다면, 이 헬레나가 당신의 수련을 도와주도록 할게요.

yes.0: 그렇다면 슬라임 40마리를 사냥해 보세요. 한 번 사냥해 본 몬스터이니 그리 어렵지는 않을 거예요. 슬라임을 모두 사냥한 후 다시 이곳으로 와서 당신이 한 일을 말씀해 주세요.

no.0: 스스로의 힘으로도 수련할 자신이 있다면, 그렇게 하는 것도 좋겠지요.

0.0: You've improved. That's not enough though. I believe you need more training. What do you say? If you want, #p1012100# can help you out with training.

yes.0: Hunt #r20 #o1210102#s#k. You've done it before, so it won't be hard. After hunting #o1210102#, come back here and report to me.

no.0: It's good to train by yourself.

1.0: You've eliminated 20 #o1210102#s. Fantastic. I'm happy with your progress. But, don't be satisfied with this. You're still weak compared to many monsters in Maple World.

yes.0: I'll call you when you need more training. Until we meet again...keep training hard!

mob.0: You haven't eliminated #r20 #o1210102#s#k yet. Don't be afraid! You can do it!
